resolution.note: repository-workflow.md scopes the lead role to an explicit brief; other sessions commit in their own checkout. Cause runs: a571f02e, 3704c335, e2a289fe, 5ab5806b (B), fc0cfa02 (S); test/rules/session-role.test.ts.

title: Stop workers committing into their own .krn worktree when the brief asks for none
body:
FR-40 arm B lost 4 of 19 agent-state units (clamp, dedupe, mask, slug) to "no commit after base": the agent committed on a branch in .krn/worktrees/<name> instead of the scored checkout (final messages in .krn/runs/fr40-campaign/evidence/fr40/runs/*/stream.jsonl for those units; arm S lost 1 the same way). The other 3 B losses came from task-id records in a brief without a task id, fixed in t-b9zs937 by the task-id precondition in src/brain/packet.ts.
Find which packet record or repository instruction sends a worker into its own worktree when the brief does not ask for one, and fix it at the owner (packet text, record, or lead-only instruction scope).
Acceptance: a test names the cause (for example: no measured record tells a worker to create a worktree, or krn-lead worktree steps are scoped to the lead); the fix cites the four run ids.
